subject: Air freight quote to MEL
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you quote me your fastest air freight option to MEL (Melbourne, AU)?

The machine parts will be ready for pickup at our site in 60504 Frankfurt am Main, Germany, on 2026-11-24. There are 4 pieces, with a gross weight of 1431 kg and a total volume of 10.71 cbm.

Could you include the truck from our site to the airport in your all-in price in EUR and let me know the earliest arrival you can offer?

Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
